suggested_snapshot_fields_to_add.why: Exposes exact one-turn move/fast_move landing cells so the planner can target predicted landings deterministically.

Precomputed booleans for exact target-cell match, hit/intercept coverage match, exact end-cell match, allowed-end membership, and forbidden-end violation reduce aim-vs-hit mistakes and whitelist misses.
Helps melee/pressure units prefer advancing options when retreat is not explicitly requested.
